تطللن (form I)
# تَطْلِلْنَ (taṭlilna) /tatˤ.lil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of طَلَّ (ṭalla)
# تُطْلَلْنَ (tuṭlalna) /tutˤ.lal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of طَلَّ (ṭalla)
